title: Eigersstor Noblerot
summary: Use for camp supplies, drink it, or throw it to spill Alcohol.

fields.Camp supplies: Contributes 4 Camp Supplies toward a Long Rest.
fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Drink one bottle. Alcohol gives disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for 2 turns.
fields.Throw: Action. Break the bottle to create a permanent, 13 ft-radius Alcohol surface. The surface is flammable.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay, acquisition, and pinned source evidence.
